title: The Discipline Routine for Busy People: The Rule That Makes It Stick
description: A sustainable discipline routine for busy people starts by making important habits easier to begin, not by squeezing more into an already full day. Learn how to use daily non-negotiables, behavioral anchors, protected attention, minimum versions, and planned recovery without relying on perfect schedules. The article also explains a simple five-to-ten-minute shutdown routine for closing open loops. Tap to read the full guide.
alt_text: Infographic about a discipline routine for busy people, showing three core ideas: daily non-negotiables, behavioral anchors, and protected attention, with a simple structured layout.
hidden_hook: The article explains a five-to-ten-minute shutdown routine that closes open loops, identifies tomorrow's most important task, and signals that the workday is finished.
